_comment: EASIEST: run wire-local.sh (mac/Linux) or wire-local.ps1 (Windows) — it fills both paths for you and verifies they match. The block below is the manual fallback.
_comment2: Paste only the 'agora' block into your Claude Desktop mcpServers config.
_comment3: Edit ONE path: the absolute path to agora_mcp.py in THIS repo. The workspace (~/.agora/main) is shared as-is across surfaces — the Agora server expands ~ itself, so leave it literal.
_comment4: Windows: use 'python' instead of 'python3' if python3 is not on your PATH.
